section: Maine property tax: state rules
label: Levied by
value: Municipalities (482); the State assesses and bills in the Unorganized Territory; county taxes are apportioned to them
note: Maine Revenue Services acts as the local assessor in areas outside organized municipalities.
source_title: Maine Revenue Services: Property Tax Division

section: Maine property tax: state rules
label: State oversight
value: Maine Revenue Services, Property Tax Division
note: Sets the annual state valuation, trains and certifies assessors, and assesses the Unorganized Territory.
source_title: Maine Revenue Services: Property Tax Division

section: Maine property tax: state rules
label: Homestead exemption
note: Up to $25,000 of just value for a permanent resident who has owned a Maine homestead for at least 12 months.
source_title: Maine Revenue Services: Property Tax Exemptions

section: Maine real estate transfer tax
label: Real estate transfer tax rate
value: $2.20 per $500 (or fraction) of the value transferred
note: Applies to deeds and to transfers of a controlling interest in an entity owning Maine real estate.
source_title: Maine Revenue Services: Real Estate Transfer Tax

section: Maine real estate transfer tax
label: Who pays the transfer tax
value: Half by the seller (grantor), half by the buyer (grantee)
note: Collected by the county or regional register of deeds.
source_title: Maine Revenue Services: Real Estate Transfer Tax

section: Maine real estate transfer tax
label: Additional transfer tax on value over $1 million
value: Additional $3.80 per $500 (or fraction) of value above $1,000,000
note: New for transfers on or after November 1, 2025 (PL 2025, c. 388). Combined with the base rate, $6.00 per $500 on the part above $1 million.
source_title: Maine Revenue Services: Real Estate Transfer Tax
